description: This file defines the absl::Span template class for referencing contiguous array data without owning it, along with related factory functions, operators, and utilities. It provides a lightweight, non-owning view into arrays or containers, supporting mutable and immutable data, bounds-checked access, and subspan operations.

classes.name: absl::Span
classes.description: A template class representing a non-owning, lightweight view into a contiguous sequence of elements of type T, supporting mutable and immutable access, subspan operations, and comparison operators.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying array data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the span.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the size of the span (alias for size()).

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the span is empty.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Provides element access with bounds assertion.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Provides bounds-checked element access.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns a reference to the first element.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns a reference to the last element.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns const iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator just beyond the last element.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns const iterator just beyond the last element.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: crbegin
methods.description: Returns const reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator before the first element.

methods.name: crend
methods.description: Returns const reverse iterator before the first element.

methods.name: remove_prefix
methods.description: Removes the first n elements from the span.

methods.name: remove_suffix
methods.description: Removes the last n elements from the span.

methods.name: subspan
methods.description: Returns a subspan starting at position with specified length.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a span of the first n elements.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a span of the last n elements.

methods.name: AbslHashValue
methods.description: Hash function support for Span.
